title: Displacement magnitude A→O
description: Essential: The displacement magnitude from A to O must be correctly stated as R.

title: Displacement direction A→O
description: Essential: The direction of the displacement from A to O must be correctly identified (e.g., West or along the negative x-axis).

title: Displacement magnitude A→D
description: Essential: The displacement magnitude from A to D must be correctly calculated as √2 R.

title: Path length calculation
description: Important: The total distance traveled along the specified curve ABCOADC to point D must be correctly summed, accounting for the full and partial circular arcs.

title: Distance A→D
description: Essential: The final distance traveled from A to D must be correctly stated (e.g., 2.5πR or 5πR/2).

title: Vector vs. scalar confusion
description: Pitfall: Confusing displacement (vector) with distance traveled (scalar) in either part of the answer.

title: Path geometry interpretation
description: Important: Correctly interpreting the Bagua diagram geometry to identify the coordinates or straight-line paths for displacement calculations.

title: Arc length formula application
description: Optional: Explicitly showing the use of the arc length formula (s = rθ) for the curved sections of the path.
